items.title: Houlihan Lokey Finds Size-Weighted Defaults in Private Credit Nearly Doubled in the Third Quarter, Reaching a Near-Term High With Smaller Borrowers the Most Impacted
items.why: Rising private credit defaults point to tighter funding and more cautious lending conditions across the market.
items.summary_ai: Houlihan Lokey reports size-weighted private credit defaults nearly doubled in Q3, with smaller borrowers hit hardest.
items.take: Rising private credit defaults point to tighter funding and more cautious lending conditions across the market.
